{{Quote|Say, Pal, didja know yer shoelaces was untied?''"<br />"''Gosh, no. Thanks. I guess they must've&mdash;hey, waita-minit! Stormtrooper boots don't have laces!|A disguised [[Fenn Shysa]] tricks an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 69">[[Star Wars (1977) 69|''Star Wars'' (1977) 69]]</ref>}}
'''Shoelaces''' were a way to secure a shoe or [[Boot/Legends|boot]]. [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] boots did not use shoelaces.

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
At the beginning of [[Roan Novachez]]'s second year at the [[Jedi academy]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], he was delighted at the arrival of his friend [[Bill]] because he understood [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Language/Legends|language]]. The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[RW-22]] had been following him around and Bill was able to explain that he was trying to tell Roan that his shoelaces were untied.
{{Noncanonend}}
